plan.title: Household Survey Coverage Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Village and enumerator coverage with submission trends over time

panels.title: Total households surveyed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM household_survey

panels.title: Unique villages covered
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT village) AS n FROM household_survey

panels.title: Unique enumerators
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT enumerator_name) AS n FROM household_survey

panels.title: Top 10 villages by survey count
panels.sql: SELECT village, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 enumerators by survey count
panels.sql: SELECT enumerator_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly submission trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(_submission_time AS TIMESTAMP)) AS month, COUNT(*) AS submissions FROM household_survey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Recent submissions (last 30 days)
panels.sql: SELECT _submission_time, village, enumerator_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM household_survey WHERE _submission_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 20

plan.narrative: This dashboard tracks the coverage and progress of the household survey program. {{p1}} households have been surveyed across {{p2}} unique villages, with {{p3}} different enumerators contributing to the data collection. The top villages by survey count are shown in panel 4, while panel 5 highlights the most active enumerators. Panel 6 illustrates the monthly submission trend, showing how survey completion has evolved over time. The recent submissions table (panel 7) provides a snapshot of the most recent activity, which is crucial for monitoring current fieldwork progress. The data reveals that while some villages and enumerators are more active, the overall program shows steady growth in coverage.
